The West Bengal School Service Commission is expected to release the WBSSC Group C and D result 2026 soon on its official website @westbengalssc.com. Candidates who appeared in the examination will be able to check the qualifying status by downloading the Result PDF along with the merit list. The result will include important details such as candidates name, roll numbers and cut off marks. The Commission conducted the Group C exam on 1 March 2026 and Group D exam on 8 March 2026. More than 16 lakhs candidates appeared for the exam. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website for the latest updates. Read below to know more about Group C and WBSSC Group D Result 2026, expected date and steps to check the result.

WBSSC Group C And D Result 2026

The West Bengal School Service Commission conducted Group C and Group D exams on 1st and 8th March 2026 across the state. A large number of candidates appeared for the examination. The WBSSC Group C And D Result is expected to be released in the last week of August 2026 on the official website @westbengalssc.com. Candidates who qualify will be called for the next stage of the selection process.

WBSSC Group C And D Result Overview

The West Bengal SSC Group C Result 2026 and Group D result will be released soon online in PDF format. The result will consist of the list of shortlisted candidates and applicants can check their qualifying status by searching their roll numbers in the PDF. Candidates can refer to the following table.

WBSSC Group C and Group D Answer Key 2026

The West Bengal School Service Commission has released the provisional WBSSC Group C and Group D answer key 2026 on 2 April 2026 on its official website @westbengalssc.com. Candidates who appeared in the examination can download the answer key to check their recorded responses and estimate their scores. The answer key is available for Group C and Group D posts. Candidates are given an opportunity to raise objections within the stipulated time. After reviewing the objections the final answer key will be released.

Click Here To Check WBSSC Group C Answer Key 2026

Click Here To Check WBSSC Group D Answer Key 2026

WBSSC Group C and Group D Result 2026 PDF Link

The WBSSC Group D Result 2026 and Group C result will be activated soon on its official website @westbengalssc.com. Candidates will be able to download the result and merit list directly once it is released. The result will be published separately for Group C and Group D posts. Candidates are advised to keep checking the official website for latest updates. A direct link will also be provided here for easy access.

Direct Link to Download WBSSC Group C And D Result 2026 PDF (Active Soon)

How to Check WBSSC Group C and Group D Result 2026?

Candidates who appeared for the exams conducted on 1st and 8th March 2026 can check the result online through the official portal once it is released. Candidates can follow the steps given below to access and download the result.

  1. Visit the official website @westbengalssc.com.
  2. Click on the WBSSC Group C And D Result link.
  3. Enter roll number and click on submit button.
  4. The scorecard will be displayed on the screen.
  5. Download the PDF and save it for future reference.

Details Mentioned on WBSSC Group C and Group D Result 2026

The WBSSC Group C and D Result 2026 contains important information regarding the performance in the examination. Candidates should carefully verify all the details mentioned in the result. In case of discrepancy candidates should contact the recruiting body for correction. The details mentioned in the result are as follows.

  1. Name of the candidate
  2. Roll Number
  3. Category (UR/OBC/SCT/ST/EWS/PwBD)
  4. Marks Obtained in the examination
  5. Qualifying Status

What After WBSSC Group C and Group D Result 2026?

After the WBSSC Group C Result 2026 and Group D result is declared by the West Bengal School Service Commission shortlisted candidates will move to the next stage i.e., Document Verification. Only those whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF will be shortlisted. Candidates must carry all original documents for verification. It includes educational certificates, ID proof and category certificates.

Document Required for WBSSC Group C and Group D Document Verification

Candidates shortlisted in WBSSC Group C And D Result 2026 released by West Bengal School Service Commission must carry the following original documents for verification. The documents are as follows.

  1. Madhyamik (Class 10) Certificate and Marksheet
  2. Class 12 Certificate and Marksheet for Group C / Class 8 Certificate for Group D
  3. Date of Birth Proof
  4. Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-A/OBC-B/PwD) if applicable
  5. Domicile Certificate of West Bengal
  6. Aadhar Card or any valid government photo identity card
  7. Recent passport size photographs
  8. Admit Card of written test
  9. Experience certificate (if applicable)

WBSSC Group C and D Result 2026 FAQs

Ques: What is the WBSSC Group C And D Result Date?

Answer: The result is expected to be released soon on the official website @westbengalssc.com.

Ques: How can I check my WBSSC Group C and Group D Result 2026?

Answer: Candidates can check the result by visiting the official website @westbengalssc.com.

Ques: What details are mentioned in the result?

Answer: The WBSSC Group C and Group D Result includes the name of the candidate, roll number, category, marks obtained and qualifying status.

Ques: What is the next stage after WBSSC Group C and D Result?

Answer: Candidates who qualify the written exam will be shortlisted for the document verification.

Ques: What is the WBSSC Group C Result Date 2026?

Answer: The result is expected to be released in the last week of August 2026.

Ques: What is WBSSC Group D Result Date 2026?

Answer: The result is expected to be announced in the August 2026.
